notes.title: Lyratha 0.8 a General Update
notes.notes:
- New "doors game" added (The new biom has an own Puzzle game)

- All biomes have been completely redesigned
- Stone and forest are much more detailed and offer much more variety
- The old wooden labyrinths were removed and exchanged to "mansion hall".    They have their own traps and idiosyncrasies
- Snakes and Abyss worms have been replaced and improved.
- New graphics option mode to adjust performance
- extensive performance updates for textures and objects
- luminous points now provide assistance
- Tutorial revised and shortened. Help and texts improved
- Many bug fix

notes.title: Lyratha 0.7.3a Update
notes.notes:
- New Skill system! The old ranking system including the experience system was removed
Now you get your skill points directly with the Keystones
- New balance (enemy/potions/spells) also new spawn rate of enemies
- New Portal Machine! As a result of the new machine, the labyrinth sizes have also been revised
- Great Performance Upgrade! The workrooms in particular are now running much more system-efficiently
- Loading Time reduced! Due to a different loading method and some improvements, the computing times at the start of the game have decreased significantly
- Early access warning! Due to many misunderstandings, the game now contains a short text when it starts
- Door in the launch room removed
- new Fog and Post Processing effects
- New “Gamma” methode
- Many bug fix
